result.entry_context_assessment: BUY entry occurs after a prolonged base between SL and Entry, with break-bar open (purple) preceding actual entry (blue triangle). Context is a late breakout from range after repeated near-SL probes, not an immediate post-base rejection at the verticals.
result.path_anatomy: Post-entry path shows only shallow adverse excursion below Entry while remaining well above SL, then a continuous bullish staircase through Entry to the TP band (purple X near ~1.0002) and further extension toward ~1.0010. This is clean directional continuation after limited MAE, not an immediate failed break, whipsaw non-acceptance, or favorable-then-giveback of the win.
result.book_trace_relevance: The full-break-bar book panel is mildly positive (early +0.051, late +0.034, score +0.035) but visually noisy and two-sided around zero rather than a decisive one-way surge. Book trace therefore only weakly coheres with the eventual extreme up-path and does not, by itself, visually discriminate this winner as uniquely inevitable; no rescue rule is implied.
result.exit_geometry_assessment: Geometry is asymmetric long: Entry~0.99922, SL~0.99875, TP~1.00015, with reward distance roughly ~2× risk, matching labeled R=+2.043. Purple X aligns with first TP-zone approach; subsequent price remains above TP, consistent with target capture then free extension under EXTREME_WIN labeling.
result.failure_mechanism: No failure mechanism is realized on this chart: stop was not threatened after entry, TP was reached after only shallow MAE, and the closed R was not given back on the disclosed path.
